descriptor: Homeware shop with hidden offers under the corner

voice.summary: Marlow & Pine writes like a friendly shopkeeper who leaves little surprises in the bag. Short, tactile phrases about linen, ceramic and brass, with a gentle wink when there is a code to find.
dos: Describe the material and the feel in one phrase
Hint at the offer instead of announcing it
Keep prices and codes plain and legible
donts: Do not use countdown pressure or fake scarcity
Never hide the terms of a code

taglines: Linen, brass, ceramic and a secret
Lift the corner, find the code
boilerplate: Marlow & Pine is a homeware shop selling linen, ceramics, brass and oak for everyday rooms, with small offers tucked under the corner of each product card.

microcopy.success: Code copied. Use it at checkout.
microcopy.error: Could not copy that code. Select and copy it by hand.

logo.note: A sprout hints at living, growing homes and echoes the pine in the name.
